root_cause: In the OOL-forwarding branch of WasmArrayObject::obj_moved(), the intended bitwise-OR operation (`uintptr_t(oolHeaderNew) | 1`) that sets bit 0 of the forwarding pointer while preserving the pointer's upper bits was mistakenly written as a bitwise-AND (`uintptr_t(oolHeaderNew) & 1`). Since OOL header pointers are always aligned (bit 0 naturally clear), the AND operation always yields 0, destroying the forwarding pointer entirely instead of merely setting its tag bit.
